title: Chapter 6392: Are You The Boss’ Son?

Chapter 6392: Are You The Boss’ Son?

Chapter 6392: Are You The Boss’ Son?

“Are you the boss’ son?” The first suddenly asked Li Qiye.

“No.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“He’s not our boss’ son.” The first told the second.

“Obviously, you can’t just ask random people this question. It’s rude.” The second said.

“What random people?” The first said: “He looks the part.”

“Where? Clearly not a good guy, I don’t see any semblance.” The second circled Li Qiye and took a good look.

“Go away, he is an ancestor of Desolate Frontier, not your boss’ son or whatever.” Alch-deer waved like he was swatting a fly away.

The two fools ignored him. The first circled Li Qiye and said: “Well, the boss is not a good person, so his son won’t be one either.”

“True.” The second hesitated after hearing this.

“Are you a good guy?” The second asked.

“No.” Li Qiye said with a smile.

“See, didn’t I tell you? He’s definitely our boss’ son.” The first jumped excitedly, leaving Alch-deer speechless.

“Both the father and son are bad, maybe you’re right.” The second scratched his head.

“Darn right, our boss’ son!” The first nodded.

“Hey, are you our boss’ son?” The second asked again.

“No.” Li Qiye patiently responded.

“Look, he’s saying no.” The second stared at the first.

The first pulled Li Qiye’s sleeve and whispered: “Just say yes, we have something good for you, it’s amazing.”

Alch-deer came closer and asked: “What is it?”

“None of your business! Stand aside!” The first glared at him.

“Hey, this is not how you behave toward another.” Alch-deer was peeved but was ignored.

The other came closer and whispered: “Just say yes and we will give it to you, it’s something even immortals desire.”

“Even immortals? Really?” Alch-deer took a deep breath.

“Obviously, it cost us eighty million years.” The first said.

“That’s right, we’re not stupid and wouldn’t have wasted that much time for nothing.” The second added.

Alch-deer remained skeptical.

“Just say it, tell us that you’re the boss’ son.” The first begged Li Qiye.

“I’m not.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Say yes and we’ll take you to get that treasure immediately, it’s incredible.” The second added.

“What can I do when it’s not the truth.” Li Qiye waved his hand.

“What now?” The second asked the first.

“Maybe find another kid, I mean, the boss’ son.” The first scratched his head.

“Wait, the boss will know, let him recognize his own son.” The second came up with a great idea.

“He’s not the boss anymore so he can’t recognize anything even if he wants to.” The first disagreed.

“Right…” The second stared at Li Qiye.

“It’s no problem that you’re not the boss’ son, just say that you are and we will give it to you, it is definitely worth it.” He said.

“Not interested.” Li Qiye stared at them before answering.

“He’s not interested, what now?” The second asked the first.

“I don’t know, I’m not a worm in his stomach, I don’t know what he wants.” The first said before telling Li Qiye: “Say, what are you interested in?”

“You two can’t fulfill my desires.” Li Qiye said.

The second immediately glared at him and said: “Don’t look down at others with your dog eyes. Tell us, what can’t we do?”

“You might be the boss’ son or you might not be the boss’ son, but just know one thing, we are stronger than the boss.” The first said.

“Really?” The second interjected.

“Obviously, he couldn’t wait and do nothing for eighty million years, only us.” The first said.

“True, he would have been spotted long ago.” The second nodded.

“Of course, the dogs would have noticed us. The boss got old and died, we surpassed him already.” The first gloated.

“Yes, yes, he can’t compare to us even if he were alive right now.” The second said confidently.

“See, now go on, tell us.” The first pulled up his sleeves.

“Yeah, tell us!” The second shouted.

“You two can do anything?” Li Qiye smiled.

“Speak already!” The first became impatient.

“Can you two go fetch an octopus?” Li Qiye asked.

“Octopus? Where?” The first looked around.

“Idiot, not an octopus,

that

octopus.” The second understood.

“What are you talking about, octopus this octopus that?” The first said.

“The one below. We were there before.” The second said.

“The octopus below? What? We were there?” The first said.

“Yes, that one.” The second nodded.

“Fuck, that’s no octopus.” The first staggered backward.

“Yeah, but it looks like one.” The second said.

“You’re talking about

that

octopus?” The first asked Li Qiye, clearly afraid.

“That’s the only one that is hard to get.” Li Qiye said.

“Right…” The first contemplated.

“Should we go get it?” The second said softly, not wanting to do it.

“Get what? That’s courting death.” The first said.

“Yes, it might eat us.” The second said.

“It will.” The first said.

“Looks like you two can’t do everything then.” Li Qiye said.

“...” The two exchanged glances.

“It’s raining.” The first suddenly looked at the sky.

“No?” Alch-deer also looked up.

“We have to bring our clothes inside!” The second shouted and ran away.

“Gotta go!” The first also ran.
